country.name: Tanzania

default_in_force_rule.text: Not applied: every version is dated by TanzLII's own expression date, the day the amendment it incorporates took effect (or the date a Revised Edition is as at) as Laws.Africa records it. No date is computed from a default rule.

country.licence_note: Source: TanzLII (https://tanzlii.org), a project of the Judiciary of Tanzania, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International licence (CC BY-NC 4.0).

sources.name: TanzLII (Judiciary of Tanzania, on the Laws.Africa Peachjam platform)
sources.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting TanzLII as the source (https://tanzlii.org/terms-of-use/)
sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act, /akn/tz/act/<year>/<num>/eng@<date> (ordinances /akn/tz/act/ord/...). TanzLII's terms prohibit scraping, so no TanzLII document page was fetched: each expression page is read from an Internet Archive capture (raw id_ form) through the shared client gitlaw_common/wayback.py; the capture timestamps and sha256s are pinned in sources.json. TanzLII's open legislation listing (/en/legislation/?years=Y) was read once per act to name the current expression. Request count covers the Internet Archive and those listing pages.

sources.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.licence: Archived copies of TanzLII pages; the content licence is TanzLII's
sources.notes: CDX API for discovery, then https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<original url> for the page bytes. Common Crawl was to be tried first (coordinator's fast-access rule), but index.commoncrawl.org refused connections from this machine on 2026-10-28.

ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the Tanzania configuration and scripts and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py, constitution.py and the shared peachjam.py are deterministic code.
